metadata.description: Iron Horse Golf Club is located between Mahoney State Park and Ashland NE, just minutes from Omaha and Lincoln. This unique golf course is built around an old rock quarry and features incredible views and exceptional beauty. We hope our website gives you a small hint of the amazing golf experience that awaits you at Iron Horse. The course begins next to Lake Iron Horse and plays to the west. There is OB to the left, the fairway opens up to the right more than it appears from the tee box. Iron Horse tees up a very intimidating shot on 18 with an out of bounds to the left and Lake Iron Horse to the right. The landing area is much larger than it looks from the tee box. Trust your swing and favor the left side on this scenic hole. What a view from the tee!

metadata.description:
Quarry Oaks Nebraska's premier golf course, is an inherent part of the scenic Platte River Valley panorama. With it's majestic tree lined fairways, Quarry Oaks is nestled quietly into the natural landscape of ridges and valley's, limestone enriched terrain, native vegetation and wildlife. The diversity of the course includes:
Spectacular elevation changes, water on several holes and an abandoned quarry area on the Par 3 15th. You will also find a breathtaking approach shot to the half-island green at the beautiful Par 4 17th. Quarry Oaks was named one of "America's 100 Greatest Public Golf Courses." - Golf Digest, 2003-2004, 2005-2006 and received a four (out of five) star rating from Golf Digest Magazine.

metadata.description: Welcome to Nebraska's premier multiple award winning 18 hole Championship Golf Course.  Woodland Hills is located south of Eagle between Lincoln and Omaha, it is always just a short drive away. Jeff Brauer designed this course for all different skill levels of players.  Tees are located for a Par 71 at distances from as short as 4,945 yards all the way to 6,600 yards. Woodland Hills Features Bent Grass Fairways, Tees and some of the best Bent Grass Greens in North America. 36 different bunkers, 84 different tee boxes, and water that comes into play on 6 holes makes Woodland Hills not only beautiful but an enjoyable challenge for all levels of players. Featuring an enormous all Bent Grass three tier driving range for practice or just a quick warm-up. Woodland Hills Golf Course offers the state of the art in GPS course management systems.  Each golf cart is equipped with the ProLink system that provides accurate yardage to the pin and all other critical points on the golf course.
